name: yakrobot-simulator
description: Browser simulator for the yakrobot-4wd skid-steer rover

scripts.deploy: test -f public/models/yakrobot-4wd.glb || { echo 'Missing public/models/yakrobot-4wd.glb: run npm run cad -- yakrobot-4wd && npm run model' >&2; exit 1; }; npm run build && wrangler deploy
